configurePresets.name: conan-base
configurePresets.description: Shared settings for all Conan-driven presets. Run `conan install . --output-folder=build/<preset-name> -s build_type=<Release|Debug> -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing` for the matching preset name BEFORE running `cmake --preset <preset-name>`, so that build/<preset-name>/conan_toolchain.cmake exists.

configurePresets.name: linux-release-asan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/linux-release-asan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. Sanitizers are applied via cmake/Sanitizers.cmake (GCC/Clang only, Debug recommended).

configurePresets.name: linux-release-tsan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/linux-release-tsan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. Sanitizers are applied via cmake/Sanitizers.cmake (GCC/Clang only, Debug recommended).

configurePresets.name: linux-asan-ubsan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/linux-asan-ubsan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. ASan+UBSan compose on GCC/Clang; UBSan runs with -fno-sanitize-recover (UB aborts). Instruments every first-party lib + the test binary (#104).

configurePresets.name: linux-coverage
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/linux-coverage -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. FULLA_TEST_COVERAGE instruments first-party libs; after ctest run gcov to emit *.gcov.json.gz then scripts/measure_coverage.py (#105).

configurePresets.name: linux-release-lto
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/linux-release-lto -s build_type=Release -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. Opt-in LTO arm (FULLA_ENABLE_LTO=ON via cmake/Lto.cmake); used by the bench-image build with FULLA_CMAKE_PRESET=linux-release-lto. Default presets are unaffected.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/windows-msvc-debug -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. Visual Studio is a multi-config generator; build with --config Debug.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-asan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/windows-msvc-asan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. NOTE: cmake/Sanitizers.cmake currently only implements GCC/Clang -fsanitize flags; on real MSVC this preset configures and builds but emits a CMake WARNING and does NOT instrument the binary (no functional sanitizer yet).

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-tsan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/windows-msvc-tsan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. NOTE: MSVC has no ThreadSanitizer runtime; cmake/Sanitizers.cmake emits a CMake WARNING and does NOT instrument the binary. Prefer linux-release-tsan or macos-arm64-tsan for real TSan coverage.

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-lto
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/windows-msvc-lto -s build_type=Release -s compiler.cppstd=17 --build=missing. Opt-in LTO arm (FULLA_ENABLE_LTO=ON via cmake/Lto.cmake) — local compilability/ctest validation of the LTO configuration; the benchmark binary is Linux GCC.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-asan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/macos-arm64-asan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 -s arch=armv8 --build=missing. Sanitizers are applied via cmake/Sanitizers.cmake (GCC/Clang only, Debug recommended).

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-tsan
configurePresets.description: conan install . --output-folder=build/macos-arm64-tsan -s build_type=Debug -s compiler.cppstd=17 -s arch=armv8 --build=missing. Sanitizers are applied via cmake/Sanitizers.cmake (GCC/Clang only, Debug recommended).
